reviewed_upstream.observation: QymCAD shape operations include typed transform/copy entry points over its native C ABI.
Placement is expressed by transforming a profile/path; no separate matrix service is exposed.

rationale: The matrix/frame/pattern service is new safe Rust; the B-Rep application is a new OCCT 8.0.1 adapter (BRepBuilderAPI_GTransform + ShapeFix). QymCAD exposes typed transform/copy asks over its own native ABI with a different naming model, so no code is copied; only the ABI idea (typed request in, one complete result out) is aligned.
not_reused: QymCAD Roles/GeoName naming and its native C ABI.
QymCAD has no placement-frame/pattern policy service; the bake/instance policy is OM9's.
l3_scope: rigid orientation from two or three reference points
